purpose: Teach: 通告/知らさ/運送/日報/年内/償却/用地/代わる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、中止の通告、来ないようにな。
lines.en: Ren — make sure that stop-notice doesn't come.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Even pace. No inflection on the name — stating a fact. Slight pause before the instruction, as if setting expectations that matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクト進捗、メンバーに、共有し、知らされています。
lines.en: Yes. I've shared the project progress with the team members.
lines.style: Clipped, formal. Quick attack on 'Yes.' Speaks in sequence like he's checking boxes. Careful precision — he's aware he's being assessed. No waver.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究機器の運送、業者と、手配しろ。
lines.en: Arrange the shipping of the research equipment with the vendor.
lines.style: Brief, task-like. Flat delivery. Not unkind, but efficient — this is expected to be done. No elaboration. The finality of someone who trusts you'll understand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の日報、しっかり、つけております。
lines.en: Yes. I'm keeping the daily research log properly.
lines.style: Steady, almost dutiful. Slight emphasis on 'properly' — small note of pride in doing this right. Speaks as if proving something small but real. Respectful pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文提出、年内に、間に合わせろ。
lines.en: Get the paper submitted before the year ends.
lines.style: Calm firmness. Weight on the deadline. Not harsh, but non-negotiable. The tone of someone stating what success looks like. Slight pause before the deadline mark.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の償却計算、勉強しております。
lines.en: Yes. I'm studying the research fund depreciation calculations.
lines.style: Earnest uptake. Slight breathiness — he's ambitious and wants to show readiness beyond what's asked. Quick, almost eager pace. The nervous preparation of someone trying to be indispensable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 共同研究の用地、大学側と、調整しろ。
lines.en: Coordinate with the university on the joint research site.
lines.style: Task-stated. Direct gaze held. Economical — no extra words. The instruction of someone who expects action, not discussion. Professional distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩に代わる形で、私が、発表することも、考えています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm actually considering stepping in to do the presentation in place of my senpai.
lines.style: Careful vulnerability. Quiet first — he's testing the water. Gains slight momentum as he speaks. Soft on 'considering' — not yet committed but leaning in. Watching for the reaction.
